name: shadcn-pdf
description: Generate PDF documents in React using shadcn-style components. Provides copy-paste PDF components (table, card, badge, document, section, divider, typography), a Tailwind-style tw() resolver, and pre-built block templates (invoices, salary slips, reports).

skills.name: generate-pdf
skills.description: Generate a PDF document from React components using shadcn-pdf and @react-pdf/renderer
